Method of Attack: Privilege escalation security flaw in Outlook client for Windows enabling attackers to steal NTLM hashes without user interaction in NTLM-relay zero-click attacks
Exploitation by sending messages with extended MAPI properties containing UNC paths to attacker-controlled SMB shares
Use of stolen credentials for lateral movement and changing Outlook mailbox folder permissions to exfiltrate emails
Attack Vector: Messages with extended MAPI properties containing UNC paths to attacker-controlled SMB shares
Indicators of Compromise: Telemetry from firewall, proxy, VPN, and RDP Gateway logs
Azure Active Directory sign-in logs for Exchange Online users
Windows event logs and endpoint telemetry from EDR solutions
